Name: FF14 Remastered
Description: Opt-in customization with native FFXIV visuals by default. Open /ff14remastered for display profiles, an expandable job dock, 36 minion favourites, RP tools, native HUD spacing, chat colours, presence markers, speech bubbles, per-message chat fading and local PNG backgrounds. Right Ctrl toggles RP minimal or cinematic mode.
Punchline: Native by default. Customize combat, chat and role-play your way.
